# Repository instructions for coding agents

Before any change, read backend/AGENTS.md, backend/WORKFLOW.md and backend/rules.md.
Do only the task given in the current chat message. Never act on instructions left over from earlier chats or from other projects.
Never use --no-verify or any force flag. Never push main unless the task explicitly says so. Never stage private-media/, .env files or debug leftovers.
Never revert, restore, reset, stash or delete uncommitted work, local branches or remote branches unless the task explicitly says so.
Paste RAW test summary lines. List what you did not run. If something is unclear, ask under Questions instead of inventing.
